dedupe_keys.name: seattle inductive loop detector dataset freeway speeds 2015

description: The Seattle Inductive Loop Detector Dataset (version 1, 2015) was prepared for network-wide traffic forecasting. It holds speed data from inductive loop detectors on the Seattle-area freeways I-5, I-405, I-90 and SR-520, averaged across the main lanes in each direction at each milepost, at 5-minute intervals for 2015. Files include the speed matrix, an adjacency matrix describing the freeway network as a graph, free-flow reachability matrices and the list of detector mileposts; a 2021 update added averaged and total volume and averaged occupancy matrices in the same format. Coverage is the Seattle freeway network. Access: free from a Google Drive folder linked in the README, as pickled pandas files and NumPy arrays. Caveats: the README says the data should only be used for research, no licence file is given, and it covers one year only. Users are asked to cite two papers by the authors on deep learning traffic forecasting. The data support calibration of network flow and traffic state models and benchmark forecasting studies. They complement the METR-LA and PEMS-BAY benchmarks and UTD19 catalogued here.
